stories.title: Cisco Informational for Emergency Distrust of eMudhra Root and Intermediate Certificate Authorities
stories.summary:
Between October 17 and October 20, 2026, a critical security compromise involving Certificate Authorities that are managed by eMudhra was uncovered.

A security researcher demonstrated that the private keys for eight eMudhra intermediate certificates were fundamentally broken due to an unprecedented error in their Key Generation Ceremony (KGC) in April 2025. stories.title: Vulnerabilities in Node.js and Brotli Affecting Cisco Products: October 2026
stories.summary:

stories.summary: Elon Musk said on Saturday that chipmaker Nvidia would lose “critical” deals without its now-ousted chief executive officer (CEO) Jensen Huang.
